headline: 美國對加拿大課50%關稅
context: 美國總統川普對一大批加拿大商品課徵50%關稅，理由是加拿大「不公平對待」美國產品。加拿大民眾則說，這件事讓人很挫折。

sources.name: BBC
sources.summary: President Donald Trump has imposed a 50% tariff on a wide range of Canadian goods in retaliation for what he called "unequal treatment" of US products.
